title: Dumping it after 5 minutes of use.
body:
I want to create descriptions for my own tasks… but I cannot enter a new line which makes it difficult to bullet point things I need to consider. Wanted to use the online version and again from my cellphone there is no way to access web unless you created first a web account. It is actually asking me to pay twice. 

Really bad app. First 5 minutes using it and already dumping it.
